# E4 sports samples

Real ESPN answers fetched once on 2026-11-13 (no key) and trimmed to the fields Sara reads:
`espn-nfl-teams.json`, `espn-mlb-teams.json`, `espn-nba-teams.json` (team lists),
`espn-nfl-kc-schedule.json` (Chiefs season, incl. two games without a time yet),
`espn-mlb-kc-schedule.json` (first three Royals 2027 games), `espn-nba-scoreboard.json`,
`espn-nfl-kc-news.json` (3 articles from `news?team=12`) and `espn-nfl-injuries.json` (two teams from
the league list; the team-level `teams/12/injuries` answered empty). Odds come from E1's
`test/fixtures/e1/oddsapi-nba.json`.
